lines.text: God says if they correct their ways, He will let them live there, and not to trust deceptive words about the temple.
God asks if they will steal, murder, and burn incense to Molech, then say in His house, "We are delivered."
God asks if His house has become a den of robbers, and says He spoke to them only once.

wrong_details.wrong: He spoke to them only once
wrong_details.true: He spoke to them again and again
